info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect Actions sObjects API
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get sObject Basic Information

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Returns metadata about the specified sObject, including the object describe result and recently accessed records of that type.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Create an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

items.docs: Creates a new record for the specified sObject type. The request body must contain the field values for the new record.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to return

items.docs: Returns the field values for the specified record. Use the fields parameter to specify which fields to return. If no fields are specified, all accessible fields are returned.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Update an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Updates the specified record with the provided field values. Only fields included in the request body are updated.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Delete an sObject Record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: recordId
params.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce record ID

items.docs: Deletes the specified record. The record is moved to the Recycle Bin unless permanently deleted.
